scripts.lint: bun run --filter openseat-frontend lint && bun run --filter openseat-theme lint && bun run --filter @openseat/design-system lint && bun x eslint eslint.config.mjs eslint.shared.mjs commitlint.config.mjs tools --max-warnings=0
scripts.lint:fix: bun run --filter openseat-frontend lint:fix && bun run --filter openseat-theme lint:fix && bun run --filter @openseat/design-system lint:fix && bun x eslint eslint.config.mjs eslint.shared.mjs commitlint.config.mjs tools --fix --max-warnings=0
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter openseat-frontend typecheck && bun run --filter openseat-theme typecheck && bun run --filter @openseat/design-system typecheck
scripts.build: bun run --filter openseat-frontend build && bun run --filter openseat-theme build
